points.description: Names most of the four desirable properties: unbiasedness, consistency, efficiency, sufficiency (about three of the four, in any wording).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if one or two of the properties are correctly named.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming about three or four of: unbiasedness, consistency, efficiency, sufficiency; informal wording is fine. Give 1 mark for one or two correct properties. Give 0 if none are correct or the answer is unrelated. Extra wrong items do not cost marks unless most of the answer is wrong.
